messages:
maya: Quick status check on SGP2 region launch — milestone-level only. Are we green on routing, KMS, and data-residency handoffs?
ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: infra/sgp2-network v3 -> staging at 2024-11-06T09:10Z (canary 10%). CI: ✅
sam: Routing side — I still need final DNS zone delegation from infra team. current todo: lower prod TTL to 60s during cutover, then restore. Who will run the TTL change? @lisa? :eyes:
lisa: I can run the TTL change. Plan: 72h pre-cutover lower to 60s, cutover window 30m, rollback back to 300s after 24h. I'll post the exact steps in the runbook.
jin: KMS: security has provisioned the SG KMS key, but we need the IAM service account mapping for the private-control-plane. I opened https://internal.redwood/kms/requests/5421 — waiting on security to attach the key policy (they're OOO until EOD PT). Current blocker for Private deployment.
maya: Ok noted. Is the hosted fallback policy in place if KMS not ready? We don't want hosted traffic accidentally touching SG nodes with unenforced residency.
diego: For routing fallback: we have policy weight on nyc region set to 0.7 and sg to 0.3 during staged traffic. If KMS isn't ready, ops policy will set sg weight to 0 and route to nyc. I can automate this via the rollout job. CR is here: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/rollouts/pulls/879 (PTAL @sam @jin)
sam: Pinged for CR review. Quick look requested on the BGP path prep — main question: do we need AS-path prepend during the initial 2h? Ops usually wants prepend=1 for safety.
lisa: Yes, prepend=1 for first 2h, then remove. Also adding a health-check target on the sg ASG to avoid blackhole routes. A snippet of config I'm proposing:
```
route-policy sg-announce {
  origin local;
  as-path-prepend 1 for 2h;
  community set no-export;
}
```
jin: For data residency: logs and audit trails will land in SG Kinesis + S3 with lifecycle 90d. Compliance asked for separate billing tag `residency:sgp`. Will infra add tagging in the terraform module? I have a small PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/sgp2-tags/pull/12
maya: Owners list to confirm: network = lisa, infra/KMS = jin, release/rollout automation = diego, product stake = sam. Please reply if different.
lisa: Confirmed. I'll own DNS TTL ops & BGP prepend.
diego: Confirmed. I'll own the automated weight flip + canary monitoring hook.
sam: Confirmed for product/run-of-cutover and customer comms. I can prepare the status blurb for the console.
jin: Confirmed on infra/KMS and tagging. Will follow up with security for key policy (will escalate).
maya: Milestone timeline: staging canary tomorrow AM (09:10Z), prod canary Thursday 02:00Z, GA Friday EOD. If any blockers that change dates, call it out in this thread by EOD today.
ops-bot: Incident note created: INC-2024-3274 (sgp2-cutover) — watch window 12:00Z-15:00Z Thursday.
sam: One more ask — can someone run a quick smoke to validate latencies to sg from APAC test harness? @lisa or @diego?
lisa: I can do smoke after I push the DNS change. Expect results in ~45m.
diego: I will add the synthetic check to our canary dashboard and post graph.
maya: Thanks all. If you hit any blocker that blocks timeline, escalate in #incidents immediately. :thumbsup:
lisa: smoke results: 45ms median from SIN -> sg edge, 2% error (DNS propagation). I pushed the Terraform PR for DNS delegate: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/dns/pull/321 :thumbsup:
sam: Reviewed rollout CR, left one minor comment about retries. @diego can you address?
diego: Fixed, pushed. CR merged.
jin: Security updated KMS policy at 2024-11-05T18:22Z — confirmed access for infra-sa. Moving to green on KMS.
maya: Great — thanks everyone. I'll update the roadmap doc and notify sales and CS.
ops-bot: Deploy notification: infra/sgp2-network v3 -> prod scheduled at 2024-11-07T02:00Z (canary 10%)
lisa: I'll be on-call for the cutover.
diego: I'll monitor canary and be ready to flip weights.
sam: Standby for customer comms post-GA.
maya: Thread closed unless new blockers pop up. :wave:
